title: Unchecked UniV2 router swap return values on the ETH legs of PromotionUniV2_Eth._legB
description: The UniV2 router swap calls on the ETH legs (swapExactTokensForETH, swapExactETHForTokens) do not check the returned amounts array.
impact: Robustness/hardening only, no value leak. The swaps are bounded by the on-chain min-out floors (minEthOut / minPromoOut) plus the final minLP check; a shortfall trips a floor and reverts the whole atomic pool(). Because the floors are enforced by the router itself, ignoring the return value cannot admit an under-execution => QA.
c4Justification: Bounded by on-chain min-out floors + minLP; no value leak or availability impact => QA robustness note.
recommendation: Capture and (optionally) assert the router return amounts for defense-in-depth and clearer post-conditions, even though the min-out floors already backstop the outcome.
